notes: The loader now actually shows. It was leaving after one second while the sigil takes 1.4 seconds to draw itself, so what you saw was a half-finished mark for under a second - a flicker, not a loading state. It now holds for three seconds…

Removed the second flicker. A separate loader inside the OG widget blanks every row and restores them a quarter-second later. It is meant for when you change the layout by hand, but it was also firing on startup when the weather arrived…
The arrival itself is slower and smoother, and a late-arriving reading now extends the wait rather than appearing after the panel has already settled.
